newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares reverse trend, close lower.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares reverse trend, close lower.

text.p: Shares on the Delhi bourse shed early gains on Friday as speculators pocketed profits amid absence of buying by foreign institutional investors, brokers said.
The Delhi sensitive index closed 14.12 points down at 734.51 at the end of settlement. It was 28.39 points up in early trade.
"Major players indulged in reducing their positions," said Yogesh Sethi of brokers Vinayaka Investments.
State Bank of India was 11.50 rupees up at 283.
Larsen and Toubro gained 2.80 rupees at 251.80.
